messages:
Alec: midweek capacity check — quick heads up: eu-west-1a had a spike in spot evictions overnight, bumped our short-term GPU-hours need. Current rolling forecast for EU is ~2,100 GPU-hrs/day (about +12% vs last week).
Maria: pulled logs -> https://logs.redwood/internal/evictions/2025-10-12 — eviction cluster window 03:14–03:40 UTC, pattern looks like spot reclaim from cloud. burst-pool-2 lost 3 nodes.
Chung: confirmed. autoscaler replaced instances but warmup + image pull = ~7m, which caused a ~150–200ms tail in inference for a few routes. low-priority batch jobs queued up.
Sanjay: quick cost calc: moving 300 GPU-hrs/day from spot -> on-demand in EU would add roughly $2.6k/week. tradeoff: keep SLO vs incremental spend.
Alec: proposal: 1) throttle noncritical rerank/batch to night window for next 48h, 2) shift ~200 GPU-hrs/day of batch to us-west-2 (on-demand there), 3) temporarily move eu burst-pool-2 to 75% reserved / 25% spot mix. This avoids wholesale on-demand shift.
Maria: +1. I'll update the weekly forecast sheet and add an annotated delta line for the next 72h (expected cost +~8%). tagging @eng-sre for visibility.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-342 — EU spot churn on burst-pool-2. Priority: P2. Assignee: Chung.
Chung: created a short runbook to speed recovery: ```kubectl get nodes -l pool=burst-pool-2 -o wide
# drain problematic node and replace with reserved template
kubectl cordon node-abc123
kubectl drain node-abc123 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# patch autoscaler min for pool to keep buffer
kubectl patch hpa burst-pool-2 -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3}}'```
Alec: timeline: enact changes by 16:30 UTC today, monitor for 12h after. need an owner for each item.
Sanjay: I'll own the traffic shift and cost approval. opening a PR on infra-config with pool mix change and us-west routing rule.
Maria: I'll push updated numbers to the forecast doc and ping product on potential 5–10% latency blips on affected routes.
Chung: will run the drain + patch sequence once PR is merged and infra confirms new reserved instances ready. will report back on node churn count.
Alec: also check network plateau in eu-west-1 - noticed some NIC errors on 10% of replaced nodes, may be image/kernel mismatch. if that's true we should hold on further replacements.
Chung: noted — will include `dmesg` checks in runbook and bail if NIC errors present.
Maria: logging the expected numbers in the sheet: EU baseline 2.1k -> surge 2.4k GPU-hrs/day, US shift -300 GPU-hrs/day; projected weekly delta +$1.9k after shifting some to cheaper region.
Sanjay: fine. I'll add a short note to billing for the temporary bump.
Alec: cool — :thumbsup: Please post short status in #eng-infra when done.
Maria: will do.
Chung: starting now, will update thread with timings and final node counts.
Sanjay: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/merge/789 — contains pool mix + routing changes.
Alec: thanks all.
